title: Assembly from finite-stage identity
statement: A finite-stage identity certificate extends along the directed coefficient system; with the source-unit equation this gives the normalized reindexing identity for every common-stage object.

proof.text: Represent an arbitrary pair by its finite coefficient stage, transport the finite certificate along the directed-stage maps, and use naturality of the comparison. The source-unit equation identifies the transported source composite with the identity, yielding the displayed equation.

lean.statement:
theorem normalized_reindexing_identity_from_finite
    (C : FamilyCore l D)
    (h_certificate : NormalizedReindexingFiniteCertificate l D C)
    (h_sourceId_unit : ∀ (T : GeometricSpace D)
          (M : generalAlgebraicallyClosedConstructibleCategory l (PadicAlgCl l) T.base.left),
        letI := (C.data T).units
        HEq
          ((pullbackTensorCommonComposition l (PadicAlgCl l)
              (𝟙 T.base.left) (𝟙 T.base.left) M).hom ≫
            (C.sourceId T).hom.app
              ((commonStageDerivedPullback l (PadicAlgCl l) (𝟙 T.base.left)).obj M))
          (𝟙 ((commonStageDerivedPullback l (PadicAlgCl l) (𝟙 T.base.left)).obj M))) :
    (∀ (T : GeometricSpace D)
      (M : generalAlgebraicallyClosedConstructibleCategory l (PadicAlgCl l) T.base.left),
    letI := (C.data T).units
    (C.comparison T T (Iso.refl _)).hom.app M ≫
      (Functor.mapDerivedCategoryNatIso (C.moduleId T) ≪≫
        Functor.mapDerivedCategoryIdIso _).hom.app
          ((ordinary l T.base.left (C.data T).realization).obj M) =
    (ordinary l T.base.left (C.data T).realization).map ((C.sourceId T).hom.app M))
